The summer training camp season has come 
around once again. Running into Maruzensky 
at the camp facility, Grass Wonder 
exchanges words with her.

Their conversation over, Maruzensky walked 
away. To Grass Wonder, her back seemed 
larger than life.

However, Grass Wonder has also grown 
tremendously since last year. And with 
her, the summer training camp begins!
